text:
2. 3. 5

Aparihāniyasuttaṃ

571. Satta vo bhikkhave, aparihāniye dhamme desissāmi, taṃ suṇātha. katame ca bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā: yadidaṃ satta bojjhaṅgā. Katame satta satisambojjhago dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgo ime kho bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammāti.
